style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent rugged minimal menswear ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless studio white #FFFFFF, cool grey sweep #E9EAEB, warm off-white panel #F4F2EE and one workwear camel accent #C8873A; neutral bright high-key studio lighting with a large front-left softbox key, white-card fill, 5500K, matte knit texture with real creases and soft contact shadows only; modern geometric sans-serif with labels in #2D2D2D and thin hairline leader rules in #4A4A4F; no icons beyond hairline rules and one blank square label block; clean high-end apparel photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; model cropped below the chin or turned away, hem fully visible, stable product scale and placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented brand marks.
noDrift: no invented brand marks or legible label lettering

style.surfaceSystem: matte seamless paper sweep #E9EAEB and matte pale board #F4F2EE; no wood grain, no fabric texture under the garment
